setup: A quadrilateral is inscribed in a circle, so every vertex lies on it, and one angle is \([[angle]]\) degrees.

steps.say: Each angle of the quadrilateral is inscribed, so it is half the arc it subtends. The angle of \([[angle]]\) degrees stands on its own arc of the circle.

The opposite angle stands on the complementary arc, and the two arcs together are the whole circle, so the two angles add to half of 360: they are supplementary, and the opposite angle is \([[opposite]]\) degrees.

answer: So the opposite angle is \([[opposite]]\) degrees.
